categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies address management in src/addrman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Removes extreme sampling bias in addrman bucket selection that distorts outbound peer selection. In sparse buckets, linear scanning caused entries preceded by empty slots to be picked with up to 95.3% probability compared to 4.7% for others (PR description), undermining uniform peer diversity.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes to test files (src/test/addrman_tests.cpp and src/test/fuzz/addrman.cpp) specifically test addrman behavior rather than general test machinery.
categories.rationale: Tests of a specific subsystem belong to that subsystem rather than general test infrastructure.
